Latin word

Cedo!

Cedo! (plural cette)

give it here! hand it over! tell me!

In this lexicon

  • give it here!

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 99, 104; Ter. Ph. 950: Nōlō, volō; volō, nōlō rūrsum; cedo, cape; Plaut. Most. 373b: Vigilō, cedo bibam

Notes

  1. 1Cedo, cette: short e and short final o, so no macrons. Lewis & Short marks it cĕdo and lists it apart from cēdō, cēdere (“go, give way”); de Vaan s.v. cedo, an imperative (“give, tell”). Ruling: cedo with short vowels.

Examples

  • Cedo manum.

    give me your handPlaut. Capt. 859, Most. 332

    In the entry for give it here!

  • Cedo istum lapidem!

    Give me that stone!composed

    In the entry for give it here!

  • Cette manūs, ambō; viam trānsīmus.

    Give me your hands, both of you; we’re crossing the road.composed

    In the entry for give it here!
